termsPage.title: Terms of Use
termsPage.intro: This document sets the rules for using the prelife.net service (hereafter "PreLife" or "the Platform"). By creating an account, signing in, or using the Platform you agree to these terms; if you do not agree, do not use the service. The terms are drafted under the laws of the Republic of Azerbaijan and apply together with the mandatory rules of your country of residence.

accept.p1: These terms cover everything offered at prelife.net — the pages, your account, subscriptions, and the Platform's other tools. By creating an account, signing in, or using the service you confirm you are bound by this document.
accept.p2: This document is a public offer addressed to all users; creating an account or using the service counts as accepting the offer. If you do not agree with the terms, do not use the Platform.

service.p1: PreLife is a unified platform for exercise, nutrition, psychology, and reading: personal workout plans, recipes and meal programs, meditation and breathing practices, online session booking with psychologists, book collections, and an AI assistant. The core features are free; Premium packages add extended capabilities — current tiers and what they include are always shown on the subscription page.
service.p2: The Platform operates at prelife.net. For questions and requests: hello@prelife.net.

account.p1: You must be at least 18 years old to use the Platform. If the law of your country allows 16–17-year-olds to use online services with their own consent, such users may create an account only with a parent's or legal guardian's consent. Personal data of children under 13 is not accepted.
account.p2: Your account is yours: keep your password confidential, do not share the account with others, and notify us immediately of any unauthorized access to your account. You remain responsible for all activity carried out through your account.
account.p3: Do not provide false information, do not open an account in someone else's name, and do not use the Platform for unlawful purposes.

notmedical.p1: PreLife is a general information and guidance service on health topics; it is not a medical examination, diagnosis, treatment, or prescription. Programs, exercises, nutrition suggestions, and articles are general in nature and are not adapted to your personal condition.
notmedical.p2: Before making any health decision — especially with a chronic condition, medication, pregnancy, or an injury — consult a physician or another qualified professional. Check your body's readiness before starting new exercise or diet routines.
notmedical.p3: In an emergency, do not wait for help from the Platform: immediately call 112 (or your local emergency number) or go to the nearest medical facility.

ai.p1: The Platform's AI assistant is used to answer your questions and to build plans and suggestions. Its answers are informational, may be wrong, and are not a substitute for professional — medical, psychological, legal, or financial — advice.
ai.p2: What you write to the AI is processed to prepare an answer; do not enter other people's personal data or secrets into the chat. See our Cookie Policy for how the processing works.

sessions.p1: The psychologists presented on the Platform are independent professionals: the quality, qualifications, and professional ethics of a session are their responsibility. The Platform provides the booking, the confirmation, and payment-status tracking.
sessions.p2: After you send a booking request, the psychologist confirms or declines it; a confirmed session can be canceled from your account before it starts. Once a session has started, cancellation is no longer possible.
sessions.p3: Be respectful during sessions and messaging — the Platform's community rules apply to these interactions as well.

payments.p1: Current Premium tiers, their contents, and durations are shown on the subscription page. Packages are activated by request: you send a request, the team confirms it, and the package becomes active in your account; payment instructions are shown at confirmation.
payments.p2: The price and terms shown for a psychologist session are clarified at booking; the payment status is tracked in your account. If you cancel a session before it starts and a payment was taken, write to hello@prelife.net for a refund — refunds follow the rules shown at the time of payment.
payments.p3: If the law of your country provides a withdrawal right for distance contracts (for example, 14 days in the European Economic Area), that right is preserved; where you give express consent to start a digital service immediately, it may be limited to the extent the law allows.
payments.p4: This section does not limit your legally protected consumer rights — including consumer protection legislation of the Republic of Azerbaijan.

content.p1: Your journal entries, notes, reviews, and other materials you enter into the Platform belong to you. You grant the Platform a limited license to store, secure, and display that material back to you; this license does not grant the right to sell or mass-distribute it.
content.p2: You are responsible for your content: do not post material that is unlawful, abusive, infringes others' rights, or violates the community rules.

fairuse.p1: To keep the Platform running steadily and safely, the following are prohibited:
fairuse.li1: Sharing, selling, or renting out your account;
fairuse.li2: Automated data collection, mass extraction, or use for third-party purposes;
fairuse.li3: Unauthorized automated access, bots, and requests that disrupt normal operation;
fairuse.li4: Security testing, scanning, or vulnerability hunting without written permission;
fairuse.li5: Reverse engineering the service or circumventing technical limits;
fairuse.li6: Using the AI assistant or psychologist messaging for spam, advertising, or unlawful purposes.
fairuse.p2: Breaking these rules can lead to suspension or closure of the account.

ip.p1: The materials offered on the Platform — texts, programs, videos, images, and design — are protected by law and provided for personal, non-commercial use only.
ip.p2: Reposting, reselling, or mass-copying paid material is prohibited. When you quote the Platform, cite the source.
ip.p3: The "PreLife" name belongs to its owner; other names and marks belong to their respective owners.

data.p1: Your personal data is processed in accordance with the Republic of Azerbaijan's Law on Personal Data (including the 2024 amendments); for users in the European Economic Area, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) may also apply. Your health-related entries (mood, journal, weight history) are a category requiring special care and are visible only in your verified account.
data.p2: You have the following rights: access to your data, correction, deletion, transfer in a portable format, and objection to processing. You can exercise part of them directly — in Settings → Privacy you can download all of your data, manage your health-data consents and delete your account with all of its records; for other requests, write to hello@prelife.net.
data.p3: Sign-in (Google/Apple), email delivery, and AI processing use third-party services; their roles and the cookies they involve are explained in our Cookie Policy.

changes.p1: The Platform keeps evolving: sections, features, and the interface may change. Material changes are announced on the site and by email.
changes.p2: Continuing to use the service after revised terms are published counts as agreement to the revised terms. If you disagree, you may close your account.

liability.p1: The service is provided "as is": no warranty is given for uninterrupted availability, error-freedom, or fitness for a particular purpose. Scheduled and unexpected outages are possible.
liability.p2: To the extent the law allows, the Platform's liability is limited to the amount you paid for the service in the last 12 months; indirect damages are not covered.
liability.p3: This section does not remove liability that the law makes mandatory, or your consumer rights.

terminate.p1: You can close your account yourself — Settings → Privacy → Delete account (note: it cannot be undone and deletes all of your records). For help or questions, write to hello@prelife.net.
terminate.p2: Breaches of the rules, unlawful activity, or actions against the Platform's security are grounds for suspending or closing an account. In the event of closure, information about active packages and bookings is provided by email.

law.p1: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Azerbaijan. Disputes are first resolved amicably — by writing to hello@prelife.net; failing that, the matter is heard by the courts of the Republic of Azerbaijan.
law.p2: The mandatory consumer rules of your country of residence are preserved. Some countries' laws (for example, data-localization requirements) may not align with the Platform's infrastructure located in Azerbaijan — in that case you should not use the service under that country's laws.

cookiesPage.title: Cookie Policy
cookiesPage.intro: This policy explains which cookies and local storage prelife.net uses in your browser, why they are needed, and how you can control your consent. We allow only what is listed below — we do not use tracking, advertising, or profiling cookies.

pl_session.purpose: Keeps you signed in: recognizes your login session (deleted on sign-out).

pl_oauth.purpose: Only during Google/Apple sign-in: a technical marker to secure the flow.

pl_cookies.purpose: Remembers your answer to the cookie bar so it is not asked on every page.

sw_cache.purpose: A copy of three generic pages to show when the internet is cut (no personal data).

what.p1: Cookies are small text files your browser keeps for a site; they let the site recognize you (for example, as a signed-in user) and remember your choices. Local storage (localStorage) is a larger browser store used for the same purpose. We use both only to the extent shown below.

principle.p1: On your first visit, nothing is written to your browser until the cookie bar is answered: your language choice lives in the address itself (az/en/ru), and your theme choice lives only in the current visit's memory. If you choose "Necessary only", nothing about your choices is stored and the bar simply closes.
principle.p2: When you choose "Accept", your answer (pl_cookies) and your choices — language, theme, motion — are remembered so you are not asked again. The login session is the exception: the pl_session cookie is always needed to recognize your signed-in account — it is a strictly necessary cookie that does not depend on consent.

table.h: 3. The cookies and storage we use
table.p1: The Platform uses only the cookie and storage entries below — nothing else.

thirdparty.p1: The site itself sets no third-party — analytics, advertising, or tracking — cookies. When you choose to sign in with Google or Apple, those providers' own rules apply; email delivery and AI processing are entrusted to third-party services, but they do not install their own cookies on the site's pages.
thirdparty.p2: If a new kind of storage becomes necessary in the future, your consent will be asked for first.

control.p1: To see the bar again, delete the prelife.net cookies in your browser — the bar will reappear on your next visit. To change your choices, use the language and theme controls on the site.
control.p2: You can delete all cookies and local storage from your browser settings: this resets your choices and signs you out, but does not harm your account or your entries on the platform.

law.p1: Storage that is strictly necessary — the login session and the sign-in flow — does not require consent under the law, because the service cannot work without it. Language, theme, and motion choices are stored only with your explicit consent; consent is freely given, and refusing is no harder than accepting — the "Necessary only" button works with strictly zero writes.
law.p2: This policy is drafted in line with the Republic of Azerbaijan's Law on Personal Data, and — where applicable — the European Union's ePrivacy rules and the GDPR's transparency requirements.

rulesPage.title: Rules
rulesPage.placeholder: Be kind. PreLife is a health community: no harassment, no medical advice from non-professionals, no spam or advertising in chats and booking messages. Write to psychologists the way you would want to be written to; keep other people's personal details private. Content is for your personal journey — don't repost paid material. Breaking these rules can end bookings and accounts.

gymApp.exBenchGuide: Lie on the bench, shoulder blades pinched, feet planted. Lower the bar to mid-chest, pause a beat, then press up hard. Wrists stay straight.
gymApp.exBicepGuide: Elbows close to the body, curl the dumbbells up one smooth arc. No wrist swing — the movement lives in the elbow. Lower slowly.
gymApp.exDeadliftGuide: Bar over mid-foot, back flat, chest ahead of hips. Bend the knees, then stand up keeping the bar close to the body. Finish tall — no leaning back.
gymApp.exLatpullGuide: Take a wide grip and lean back slightly. Pull the bar to the upper chest, squeeze the lats, release slowly. Think of pulling with the back, not the hands.
gymApp.exLegpressGuide: Feet shoulder-width on the platform, knees tracking the toes. Lower to about 90 degrees and press up without locking out. The lower back stays glued to the seat.
gymApp.exLungeGuide: Step one foot forward and lower until the back knee hovers near the floor. The front knee stays behind the toes, torso upright. Drive back up and switch legs.
gymApp.exOhpGuide: Standing, bar at the shoulders. Brace the core and press straight overhead — the bar passes the face on the same line, finishing over the ears with locked arms.
gymApp.exPlankGuide: Elbows under the shoulders, body one straight line. Hips neither pike up nor sag — keep breathing and draw the navel in.
gymApp.exPullupGuide: Grip just wider than the shoulders. Pull the shoulder blades down and slightly back, then drive the body up until the chin clears the bar. Lower with control; if full reps are too hard, start with a band or negatives.
gymApp.exRowGuide: Hinge to 45 degrees with the bar hanging. Row it toward the lower ribs, squeeze for a beat, lower slowly. The back stays flat throughout.
gymApp.exRunGuide: Start at an easy pace and nudge the speed up after two minutes. Stay at a conversational effort — the goal of a warm-up is to wake up, not to tire.
gymApp.exSquatGuide: Bar on the shoulders, feet shoulder-width. Knees track over the toes as you sink, chest proud, back tight. Descend until the hips pass the knees, then drive up.
gymApp.exStretchGuide: Hold each muscle group in a gentle stretch for 20-30 seconds; no bouncing. Keep breathing steadily — the tension softens with the breath.
gymApp.exSwingGuide: Hold the kettlebell with both hands and drive with the hips — the arms stay relaxed. Power comes from the hips; the bell floats to chest height. The back never rounds.
gymApp.exTricepsGuide: At the cable station, elbows pinned to the sides; press down until the arms fully extend. Return slowly — the elbows never drift forward.

blurb.deepwork: Newport shows the real cost of fragmented attention and gives concrete rules that protect deep concentration. Every chapter ends with a tool you can turn into a habit.
blurb.flow: Csikszentmihalyi studies full absorption — flow: when, how and why some hours simply fly.
blurb.habits: Clear breaks a habit into four laws — cue, craving, response, reward — and turns each into small steps you can apply today.
blurb.meaning: Drawing on the camp experience, Frankl shows that finding meaning is a choice. One of the rare books that changes what a life means.
blurb.meditations: The Roman emperor's notes to himself — the most personal source of Stoic practice. Short, heavy, openable any day.
blurb.thinking: Kahneman separates the mind's two systems — fast intuition and slow logic — and pinpoints exactly where we go wrong.

psychApp.psyAidaBio: Fifteen years of clinical practice; trauma-informed care and individual therapy — calm, precise, structured.
psychApp.psyAidaEdu: MA in psychology, Baku State University (2010). Started clinical work in hospital centers in Baku; running a private practice for individual and trauma-focused sessions since 2012. Has led the EMDR supervision group for the past five years.
psychApp.psyAidaRules: Sessions run 50 minutes. Cancellation is free up to 24 hours in advance; later notice bills half the session. In urgent situations the psychologist reaches out herself.
psychApp.psyElmiraBio: A family-systems approach: parent–child, siblings and inherited patterns.
psychApp.psyElmiraEdu: BSU master's (2011), doctoral coursework in family therapy. Working with family systems since 2013; sees clients both in-office and online.
psychApp.psyElmiraRules: In family sessions every member's voice weighs equally. The first session is an introduction — no decisions are made on day one.
psychApp.psyGulshanBio: An EFT therapist for couples and family dynamics — find the root of the words, repair the bond.
psychApp.psyGulshanEdu: MA in clinical psychology, Ankara University, Türkiye (2008). Combines the Gottman method with a systemic approach in couples and family sessions. Seeing clients in her own office since 2010.
psychApp.psyGulshanRules: In couples work both partners must attend the first session. Payment before the session; cancellation up to 48 hours.
psychApp.psyKamranBio: Works in the language of play with children and teens — a shared roadmap with parents.
psychApp.psyKamranEdu: BSU, psychology (2012), child & adolescent specialization (2014). Six years as a school psychologist; opened his own practice in play therapy and parent consultations.
psychApp.psyKamranRules: Child sessions run 45 minutes; the parent joins the first and last 10 minutes. Nothing is done without the child's consent.
psychApp.psyLeylaBio: An MBSR teacher running group practice for a decade — quiet, precise, with a wry calm humor.
psychApp.psyLeylaEdu: BA in psychology, Azerbaijan State Pedagogical University (2013). Specialized in small groups: running online group sessions since 2015, and delivering corporate workshops as a mindfulness instructor.
psychApp.psyLeylaRules: Group sessions start on time — entry closes after a 5-minute grace window. What is said in the group stays in the group: confidentiality first.
psychApp.psyNarimanBio: EMDR-certified therapist — processing heavy experiences gently, step by step.
psychApp.psyNarimanEdu: Clinical psychology, Khazar University, Baku (2009). Completed international certification programs in trauma; running trauma sessions online since 2011 and supervising in non-profit projects.
psychApp.psyNarimanRules: Trauma work proceeds step by step — no step is compulsory. Online sessions require a calm, stable connection.
psychApp.psyRasimBio: Focus, motivation and a performance mindset — for athletes and the heavily loaded.
psychApp.psyRasimEdu: ASPU (2015). Focused on young professionals and students; trained in ACT, running online group and individual sessions since 2017.
psychApp.psyRasimRules: The first consultation is free for young clients. Small between-session exercises are offered — always optional.
psychApp.psySamirBio: Works with young adults and career stress — concrete goals, brief interventions.
psychApp.psySamirEdu: BSU, psychology (2014). Known for evening-cabinet individual sessions; partners with consulting firms on work stress and team dynamics. Works with an ACT + CBT blend.
psychApp.psySamirRules: Evening hours are in demand — bookings are confirmed 48 hours ahead. Session notes are prepared on request.
